We need DBE for C5H11O3Br. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (halogens count as H). O and S ignored. So treat Br as H. So effective H = 11 + 1 =12. No N. DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 =5 -12/2 +1 =5 -6 +1 =0. So DBE =0. Integer 0.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Could verify using tool.
